exit_state: Chapter 3 has specified source assertions, coverage, mapping, information views and dependency-sensitive corrections. A revised conclusion cannot rewrite a committed event or authorize a new correcting journal without the applicable treatment. The literature chapter must now explain which existing methods support these requirements and where their boundaries lie.
findings: The original financing retry returns its original receipt after validating its original bindings; it cannot become a fresh assessment under revised evidence.
A new treaty-order conclusion does not itself authorize reduction of an already committed asset. Unsupported treatment preserves the conditional calculation and creates no journal.
The chapter closes with the difference between a record of a correction and authority for its accounting treatment. No new confirmed defect.
